name: redwood
note: The Redwood Coast pack on Meshy. Shape prompts come from tools/blender/cartoon_redwood.py and the owner's rules on built-as-it-grows trees; colours are the game's own (src/vegetation.js shades and barks); targets are today's triangle counts, raised for the seedling, sword fern and salal. No broken tops, and redwood trunks slim with a gentle taper (the owner, 5 November 2026).
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and under each bough, lighter toward the tips. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.

models.name: Blender_Redwood_1
models.prompt: A mature coast redwood tree, 60 m tall, about a quarter as wide as tall. One straight trunk of cinnamon red-brown fibrous bark with 9 deep vertical flutes. Trunk bare for its lowest third. Above that a long narrow cone of thin tapering limbs, level to slightly drooping, carrying flat sprays of fine pointed dark blue-green needles. Open crown with sky showing through and the trunk glimpsed inside. No solid core, no lumps, no foliage balls, no cones. A slender trunk, one twenty-fifth of the tree's height wide near the ground, narrowing gently to two-thirds of that width at mid-height and to a thin point at the top, its sides never parallel. Only a small flare in the very bottom of the trunk, no wide base. Whole healthy tree, no broken or snapped top. Stylised cartoon game asset, matte hand-painted colour. Single tree alone, no ground, no base, no text.
